historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission awarded a $5,710 contract for temporary improvements to the field house at Upper Noe Valley Playground to Carroll J. Collins Construction.

The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to build Upper Noe Playground and its field house to James I. Barnes Construction Company of Redwood City at $429,000, subject to funds, after rejecting an earlier round of bids in March.

Mayor George Christopher and the commission's president were to dedicate the new Upper Noe Recreation Center, at Thirtieth and Day Streets, on the evening of Monday, July 1, the Recreation and Park Commission's general manager reported.
